description_short: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in the United States accepts applications for the Class of 2027 of the Steven M. Teutsch Prevention Effectiveness Fellowship. Applications, recommendations and unofficial transcripts are due by 11:59 pm ET on 8 January 2027.
status_evidence: Official CDC Prevention Effectiveness Fellowship pages (seen in search results) give the Class of 2027 application period as opening 8 a.m. ET on September 8, 2026 and closing 11:59 p.m. ET on January 8, 2027
The same pages state recommendations and unofficial transcripts must be received by the application deadline
Deadline is in the future relative to the run date 2026-11-20
